subject: Kickoff: Android in the Wild — device control corpus
body:
Hi Santiago, team,

Kicking off our AitW work. It's a large-scale device-control dataset: human demonstrations pairing natural language instructions, UI screens, and actions, spanning four Android versions (v10-13) and eight device types at different screen resolutions. That resolution and version spread is the reason we picked it — our instruction-following model overfits to one screen geometry today.

The corpus is five datasets: four multi-step (Install, WebShopping, General, and a first-party apps subset) and one single-step. Starting states were randomized during collection, so episodes aren't trivially memorizable.

Milestones: ingest and per-subset baselines by mid-March, resolution-robustness study in April, readout the week of May 11.

Priya
